note: Every entry is a freely redistributable homebrew build committed to a public repository. No commercial ROMs are hosted here. Covers are real 240x160 frames captured from the running emulator.

games.title: Alien Invasion
games.author: amberephraim
games.description: A fixed-screen space shooter: aliens descend in waves while your cannon picks them off from below. Written in C against the bare GBA hardware renderer.

games.title: Cyber Citadel
games.author: amberephraim
games.description: A neon-soaked side-scroller with hand-drawn title art and painted scenery. The heaviest ROM in the library at 9.5 MB, streamed only when you launch it.

games.title: Simple Frogger
games.author: amberephraim
games.description: A homebrew lane-crosser: dodge the traffic, thread the gaps, reach the far bank. Sixty frames of pure arcade timing.

games.title: Lander Advance
games.author: edefelice
games.description: A first-person lunar lander with a full cockpit: propellant gauges, RCS thrusters, a radar sweep and landing lights for night descents. Simulation mode flies it straight, Fast mode gives you a stronger ship and a shorter fall.

games.title: Pong
games.author: ZeroDayArcade
games.description: The arcade original, rebuilt as a teaching cartridge: player one against the computer, scored on a bitmap rendered straight from C. Small enough to read in an evening, precise enough to be worth winning.

games.title: Wigly Hunt
games.author: rawbits2010
games.description: Wigly is a worm who has to dive into the abyss, and the fish are hungry. Swim with the D-pad, lash left with A and right with B, and see how far down you get. Written in 48 hours for Ludum Dare 48.

games.title: Xorlix
games.tagline: Lights out, one pin at a time
games.author: egillespie
games.description: A toggle puzzle on parchment: every pin you flip changes its neighbours, and the board is only cleared when they all agree. Score, moves, bonus and a hi-score that outlives the reset.
